name: Dearest Darling Dragon
source:
You did the thing.

You went to college, graduated with honors, and got your License as a Divine Beast Educator.

But where are all the jobs?!

Applying to a suspicious Help Wanted ad, you find yourself at Princess Petra's Academy for Young Divine Beasts...

Your first ward being a mysterious egg.

Raise a baby dragon and date a hot dragon daddy in this silly and fantastical stat-raising Otome!

[Edited from [url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/dearest-darling-dragon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你做了那件事。

你上了大学，以优异的成绩毕业，拿到了神兽教育师执照。

但所有的工作都在哪里？

申请可疑的招聘广告后，你发现自己来到了佩特拉公主的幼年神兽学院……

你的第一个病房是一个神秘的蛋。

在这个愚蠢而奇幻的统计提升乙女游戏中，养育一条小龙并与一位火辣的龙爸爸约会！

[编辑自[url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/dearest-darling-dragon]itch.io[/url]]
